tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the pharmacy catalog by product name, brand, active ingredient or symptom keyword (for example: paracetamol, sunscreen, Panadol). Returns matching products with price and availability.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details of one product by its slug: description, active ingredient, how to use, warnings, price and availability.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: All product categories in the store, with the slug to pass to browse_category.

tools.name: browse_category
tools.description: Best-selling products in one category (slug from list_categories).

tools.name: current_deals
tools.description: Products on offer right now, with the discount.

tools.name: store_info
tools.description: Where the store delivers, delivery time and fee, the free-delivery threshold, and accepted payment methods.

tools.name: create_cart_link
tools.description: Make a link that opens the store's cart with these products already in it. The customer opens it, checks the cart and completes the order on the site. Nothing is ordered until they confirm there.
